units: <cite ref="Megillah 25b:17">Meg. 25ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 63b:11">Snh. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>כל ל׳ … בר מל׳ דע״א</he> all sneering is forbidden except the ridiculing of idols (by perverting their names).—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 44a:5">Ab. Zar. 44ᵃ</cite> (phonetic etymol. of <he>מ̇פ̇ל̇צ̇ת</he>, <cite ref="II Chronicles 15:16">II Chr. XV, 16</cite>) <he>דהוה מ̇פ̇ל̇יא ל̇יצ̇'</he> for it (the worship of that idol) carried lasciviousness to an extreme.
